title: World's Best Fried Chicken
description: This recipe claims to be better than KFC, featuring a unique marinade and a crispy coating enhanced with vodka.

ingredients.item: Equal parts plain flour and cornstarch
Hot oil for frying (180 degrees Celsius)

steps: Combine salt, chili sauce, garlic powder, and buttermilk for the marinade.
Marinate the chicken for a minimum of two hours in the fridge.
Mix two parts plain flour, one part corn flour, baking powder, and KFC's 11 secret herbs and spices.
Phase three: Prepare the wet batter.
Combine equal parts plain flour and cornstarch, special seasoning, two semi-beaten egg whites, and a tiny bit of vodka.
Thin the batter down with some water and mix.
Take chicken out of the buttermilk marinade and let excess drip off.
Dip into the dry mix and coat evenly.
Go back into the dry mix for one final coating.
Once all chicken is evenly coated, drop into hot oil at 180 degrees Celsius.
notes:
The vodka in the wet batter helps create a crispier coating because it is more volatile than water and evaporates quicker in hot oil. The vodka also prevents gluten from developing in the final flour coating, stopping it from becoming cakey.
